query: db.students.aggregate([ { $project: { _id: 0, name: 1, null_status: { $cond: { if: { $eq: [{ $type: "$gpa" }, "missing"] }, then: "missing", else: { $cond: { if: { $eq: ["$gpa", null] }, then: "explicit_null", else: "has_value" } } } } } }, { $group: { _id: "$null_status", count: { $sum: 1 } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, status: "$_id", count: 1 } }])
